title: Remember gate
summary: An episode is stored only when remember is explicit. Withdrawal deletes episodes and diary rows and leaves world cards.
body: HORBM research note R3, 2026-11-18: the session ring is RAM, episodic rows exist on disk only when remember was granted for that write, and withdrawal deletes user-text rows. World-knowledge rows that contain no user text stay. This crate follows that split.

sources.title: Galion Labs, HORBM R3 memory, persona, empathy, 2026-11-18
sources.author: Galion Labs
